Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!
programme.sub-title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Butternut squash and cannellini beans; a quick and easy dessert of strawberries and balsamic; roasted spaghetti squash with spicy tomato sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.
programme.sub-title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans Season 1
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.
programme.sub-title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.
programme.sub-title: Cooking as a Kid in New York

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Olive oil reigns in Lidia's kitchen, and in this episode she teaches the viewer how to use it from appetizer to soup to dessert. She'll start with a delicious Tomato and Bread Salad - a delicious tossed salad of country bread and juicy ripe tomatoes known as panzanella; a nourishing Rice and Lentil Soup and a Cannoli Napoleon, a new twist on the old cannoli: ricotta cream with crunchy almonds and chocolate layered between fried pastry.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Radicchio, endive, apple and pecorino with cheese toasts; skilled ricotta mini meatloaves dressed in a mushroom sauce.
programme.sub-title: A Meal To Make You Smile

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, the oven is on for the fish dish, the vegetable dish and for the chicken drumsticks! Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a Baked Fennel with Tomatoes and oozing Cheese. She then creates a Rollatini of Sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon and white wine.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders Season 1
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich travels the country visiting men and women who've worked quietly in the shadows and now find themselves thrust into the spotlight by crises facing the country in 2020. From coast to coast, Lidia follows dedicated police officers, firefighters, paramedics, military and medical workers, and observes the prominent role that food plays in these first responders' lives.
programme.sub-title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Spicy sheet pan pork chops and broccoli; how to revive leftover soup for an easy weeknight meal; apricot jam half-moons.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a Creamy Risotto alla Milanese with Saffron and Marrow bone followed by a Succulent Quail Stuffed with Italian Sausage and Mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Berries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.
programme.sub-title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians will wrap anything in dough, whether it's savory or sweet, and still have time for a classic. Lidia begins this meal with a savory Zucchini and Rice Crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of Zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, who has the sweet tooth in the family, joins Lidia for this segment.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Jeremy's Egg
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Jeremy is terminally ill and the only special-needs child in second grade. One day his teacher gives her students plastic eggs with the instructions to fill them with something that symbolizes Easter and new life.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: Judas has been the symbol of evil and treachery but does he deserve this reputation? Why has he continued to fascinate writers, actors and artists? It is time to re-examine his role in the Jesus story and in the centuries that followed.

programme.title: The Case for Christ
programme.desc: Lee Strobel's blockbuster bestseller comes alive on your screen in this documentary that chronicles the reporter's journey from atheism to faith. The former legal editor of the Chicago Tribune draws upon his investigative skills to examine the historical viability and accuracy of the Gospels, along with the personal claims and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Road To Emmaus
programme.desc: Bruce Marchiano stars in this dramatic production which helps viewers discover what may have happened during the miraculous journey on the Road to Emmaus.

programme.title: The Lamp
programme.desc: Life goes on? A tale of hope, wishes, dreams, and what can happen when you just believe. Two years after the tragedy a visit from a mysterious and magical messenger, who offers Stanley three wishes, just may reawaken his hope for the future. With a little help from a couple of needy foster kids next door, Stanley and Lisa find that all their wishes can come true if they just believe.

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: The church's greatest enemy became Christ's most prolific messenger. Beautifully shot in the Moroccan desert, Paul the Apostle is a sweeping saga of the man who brought the Gospel to the Western world.

programme.title: Newton's Grace
programme.desc: Newton's Grace is the true story of a real 'Prodigal Son,' the story of miraculous forgiveness and change that lies behind the powerful words of one of the world's most beloved hymns.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: From the Emmy Award-winning Bible Collection comes a production starring Richard Harris as the Apostle John. Detailing John's visions against the backdrop of the severe persecution of Christians in the first century, this biblically based film will inspire viewers.

programme.title: Hudson Taylor: Into the Heart of the Dragon
programme.desc: Into the Heart of the Dragon is a striking docudrama filmed on location in China and the U.K. It paints an intimate portrait of Taylor's life and legacy.

programme.title: The Two Thieves
programme.desc: The second short film from Vertical Church Films, The Two Thieves captures the uncommon grace and redemption of the crucifixion from a perspective that's never before been captured on film.

programme.title: Find Me
programme.desc: This moving, personal documentary tells the stories of those who adopt children from China as well as the stories of those who loved them first; The biological parents who feel they can't keep their children and the orphanage nannies or foster-families who must say goodbye to the children they've raised for months.

programme.title: Esther

programme.desc: Photographer George Cooper (John Heard) is documenting the lives of subterranean homeless people, a population that has mysteriously dwindled. After receiving information from a reporter, George becomes aware of a conspiracy theory about cannibalistic monsters lurking in the sewers. He teams up with the reporter, a policeman (Christopher Curry) and a priest (Daniel Stern) to fight two battles: one against the cannibals and the other against a corrupt government official.

programme.title: Red Headed Stranger
programme.desc: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.title: Silver City
programme.desc: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

programme.title: Going All the Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence -- and his new real estate agent Hutter's wife.

programme.title: The Boys From Brazil
programme.desc: Dr. Josef Mengele (Gregory Peck) clones Hitler 95 times, and hopes to raise the resulting boys in Brazil, giving them childhoods identical to Hitler's. His ultimate plan is to create a band of Nazi leaders that can continue where Hitler left off, forming the Fourth Reich. Ezra Lieberman (Laurence Olivier), a Nazi hunter, learns of the plan and is determined to thwart it. When the two meet face-to-face in the home of one of the Hitler clones, it is up to the boy to choose who he will assist.

programme.title: Showdown at the Grand
programme.desc: A movie theater owner must defend his family business from corporate developers alongside a legendary action star as art imitates life in a showdown for the ages.

programme.title: Suburbia
programme.desc: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

programme.title: City on Fire
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

programme.title: Rough Magic
programme.desc: In the midst of a dazzling stage show, magician's assistant Myra Shumway (Bridget Fonda) catches the eye of sleazy industrialist Cliff Wyatt (D.W. Moffett). When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Slacker
programme.desc: Austin, Texas, is an Eden for the young and unambitious, from the enthusiastically eccentric to the dangerously apathetic. Here, the nobly lazy can eschew responsibility in favor of nursing their esoteric obsessions. The locals include a backseat philosopher (Richard Linklater) who passionately expounds on his dream theories to a seemingly comatose cabbie (Rudy Basquez), a young woman who tries to hawk Madonna's Pap test to anyone who will listen and a kindly old anarchist looking for recruits.

programme.title: Nosferatu the Vampyre
programme.desc: Jonathan Harker is sent away to Count Dracula's castle to sell him a house in Virna, where he lives. But Count Dracula is a vampire, an undead ghoul living off men's blood. Inspired by a photograph of Lucy Harker, Jonathan's wife, Dracula moves to Virna, bringing with him death and plague... An unusually contemplative version of Dracula, in which the vampire bears the cross of not being able to get old and die.

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Chinese martial arts student Chen Zhen is studying in Kyoto, Japan, when he learns his mentor has died in a match against Ryuichi Akutagawa. Returning home to the Japanese-occupied Shanghai of 1937, Chen challenges Ryuichi to a fight and easily defeats him. Concluding his master was set up, Chen has an autopsy performed. Meanwhile, word of his martial arts skill entices new students hoping to study with him, making his teacher's son, Huo Ting-An, jealous.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Take Back
programme.desc: A woman embarks on a vengeful quest to save her kidnapped daughter from a mysterious man from her past.

programme.title: College
programme.desc: Brilliant in his studies and dismissive of athletics, Ronald (Buster Keaton) finishes high school at the top of his class. But in college his uptight attitude doesn't win him any points with his sports-loving classmates, and pretty coed Mary (Anne Cornwall) ignores him in favor of brutish jock Jeff (Harold Goodwin). Hoping to impress Mary, Ronald makes a buffoon of himself at every sport imaginable, usually at Jeff's hand. But Ronald gets a final shot at glory in a big rowing race.

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between the youngest daughter of a merchant who has fallen on hard times and the mysterious beast her father owes a debt to.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Jarrod (Eric Balfour) and Elaine (Scottie Thompson) take a trip to Southern California to visit his friend, Terry (Donald Faison), for a fun getaway, but it turns into a weekend of terror. During the night a cluster of strange, mesmerizing lights signals the arrival of an alien invasion. As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

programme.title: Galaxy of Terror
programme.desc: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

programme.title: McLeod's Daughters
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Lilies Not For Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Mudd was convicted for his role in the plot even though the evidence was highly circumstantial. Today, apparitions and other strange activity have been witnessed inside, and directly outside, the house. Through their investigation, the team uncovers evidence that Mudd may be trying to prove his innocence from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.desc: Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le dice a Jiménez que deben desmantelar la red de distribución que tienen los Casillas en las colonias. Los Villalobos llaman para pedir una cita con Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía propone que Aurelio pierda su anonimato. Mónica está furiosa porque Casillas no le contesta el celular. Ponte le dice a Marco Mejía que ya tiene a sus hombres listos para la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez da luz verde para ir por Casillas, y Mejía comienza un operativo para desmantelar toda la organización. Mónica le exige a Aurelio que active el negocio con Guadalupe.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos se enteran de lo que sucede con Casillas y quieren aprovechar para sacarlo del negocio. Aurelio le pide a Chacorta que les dé un susto a los periodistas para vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía trata de interceptar las comunicaciones de los Casillas, pero decide renunciar porque se siente culpable por las muertes de personas inocentes. Aurelio ordena eliminar a Eugenia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto cae en las provocaciones de Matilde. Chacorta le dispara a Eugenia, pero hiere a Linares. Mejía se enfrenta a tiros con él y es Chacorta quien resulta herido, aunque logra escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio jura que Mejía se las va a pagar. Doña Alba hace entrega de los documentos de un lote de terreno, con el fin de presionar para que reciban nuevamente a Rutila en la escuela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos secuestran a Ximena, mientras Aurelio y Mónica se reencuentran. Doris y Jiménez organizan una cena con altos funcionarios del Gobierno por el nombramiento de Benítez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia escucha la conversación que tiene Ramiro con Irina y decide arruinarlo. Juan Villalobos le dice a Ximena que están enterados de los amoríos de Heriberto y Matilde. Leonor activa su plan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo visita a Aurelio para contarle que lo quieren sacar del negocio y le pide que le dé una ruta; además, lo ayudará para rescatar a Ximena. Mejía usa una estrategia que incomoda a Jiménez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia amenaza a Ramiro con contar todo durante la reunión, pero él le advierte que, si lo hace, uno de sus socios se encargará de acabar con ella. Guadalupe atenta contra Sabino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde le reprocha a Chacorta el haber tenido un hijo con Aída. Sonia se va a confesar y le pide al sacerdote una cita con el cardenal para confesarle algo muy grave, y le da una libreta negra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Guadalupe que elimine al cardenal, pero alguien más lo hace por él. Matilde le dice a Alba que le dará un dinero a cambio de quedarse con el niño, ya que es hijo de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba le dice al Turco que algo le pasa a Ximena. Alfonso autoriza que el artículo que hizo Eugenia con respecto a la muerte del cardenal se publique sin ninguna modificación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio conoce a Leonor y comienza a coquetearle, aunque ella disimula con Alejandro. Marco Mejía visita a Ramiro en su oficina y le pregunta por Sonia: él le dice que está en Londres con su hija.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena pregunta a Aurelio si tuvo algo que ver con la muerte del cardenal. Él le promete a su esposa que va a cambiar, pero ella está decidida a escapar, por lo que le pide al Turco que la ayude.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se arrepiente de haber golpeado al Triste y le pide disculpas, dice que Casillas no le volverá a ver la cara de idiota. Ximena visita a Cleto, y el Turco se entera del plan de Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Alba descubre a Ximena a punto de huir. Aurelio les dice al Cabo y a Tijeras que les dejará el territorio de los Robles y de los Villalobos. Cleto está preocupado, no sabe nada del cargamento.
programme.sub-title: Esta vida no es para mí

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio está angustiado, le pide a su gente que suspendan todo y se dediquen a localizar a Ximena. El Topo Galván le propone a Óscar Cadena asociarse en los túneles que tiene a disposición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena decide regresar cuando Alba le cuenta que su padre está en terapia intensiva. Benítez le agradece al general Jiménez el haber detenido a don Cleto y darles un duro golpe a los carteles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio golpea a su esposa y le dice que no podrá salir de la casa sin su permiso. Leonor queda preocupada al saber que Casillas descubrió su arma. Marco le ofrece a Ximena que ayude a Cleto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Pollo le cuenta al Topo Galván que don Cleto tuvo un infarto. Cabo se deprime por lo que pasó con Mónica. Víctor toma a Matilde por la fuerza, mientras Aurelio se mete en el cuarto de Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chacorta le pregunta a Heriberto si le gusta Matilde. Ponte y Orejas descubren que el Letrudo es el mismo general Jiménez. Leonor le asegura a Mejía que el Letrudo estuvo en la hacienda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le dice a Aurelio que tiene los planos del hospital, pero que no tienen muchas opciones para liberar a don Cleto sin sufrir algunas bajas. Mientras, él se entera del plan de su suegro.
