programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. \nIn this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc:
One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. 
It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. 
For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. 
In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration \"weaponized\" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.\nThe Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.\nFrom Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.\n\nIn this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging \"AI tourism\" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.

We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.

One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI.\n#SummerDavos2026.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: The Pulse
programme.desc: “The Pulse” features musicians performing amidst Guizhou’s stunning natural scenery, bringing to life a harmonious blend of music and landscape.

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Life in the Cloud
programme.desc: The second episode faithfully records what Tianran sees and feels during the backpacking tour in Danba County, Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province. The perseverance, sincerity and hospitality of the people in Xizang leave a profound impression on the travelers visiting this land.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film \"Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon\".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise.\nKleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals.

programme.title: China Untapped: Nanjing 3
programme.desc: Join us in Nanjing’s bustling old quarter, where you can try on silk dresses worth their weight in gold, and see how traditional handicrafts have been given modern twists. We’ll feast on street snacks and local delicacies by the old Confucian Temple, before taking a pleasure cruise along Nanjing’s mother river to round off our exploration of this vibrant and historic city.

programme.title: China Untapped: Suzhou
programme.desc: CGTN’s integrated media cultural and travel program \"China Untapped: Suzhou\" features industrial tourism as its core theme, complemented by Jiangnan cultural tourism. The show follows a narrative thread of a foreign host touring the city alongside an international business investor. Serving as an explorer and guide, host Alex McCutcheon leads the entire industrial tour across Suzhou. UK businessman Athan Fox, acting as a potential investor and observer, views the city through the lens of commercial inspection and identifies the core strengths and investment potential of Suzhou’s high-end manufacturing sector. The production team traveled across Suzhou’s urban districts, Taicang, Kunshan, Changshu and other areas, visiting over 30 enterprises, research institutions and cultural tourism sites. The program presents a perfect blend of robust industrial strength and the exquisite aesthetics of Jiangnan. The two perspectives complement and validate each other, enabling global audiences to learn about Suzhou’s industrial achievements and unique charm in a way that resonates with their cognitive habits.

programme.title: Young Shaolin master
programme.desc: Xu Haican is a kung fu practitioner at the Quanzhou Shaolin Temple in Fujian. The 12-year-old boy is now an expert with the sword, the nine-section chain whip, and the monkey stick after just two years of training. Xu said these weapons give him both confidence and discipline, as he must wield them safely in practice. The young Shaolin master said he hopes to learn more from his masters and carry forward the Chinese martial art.

programme.title: The Datong Motorcycle Diaries
programme.desc: In this Episode, we explore dragon walls in Datong, the City of Dragon Walls, to create a new tourist trail. The host then rides a motorcycle along Datong’s Great Wall, presenting local culture and scenic spots along the way.

programme.title: The Pulse

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a warm atmosphere of ethnic solidarity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from \"word candy\" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet.

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game \"Sifu\" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to \"eat porridge at night\.

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the \"dos and don'ts.\.

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: \"Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.\nThough he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China.\.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Wild Wonders Ep.4
programme.desc: China's vast land features extraordinary geological diversity and climate zones. Home to 5,000 years of civilization and 1.4 billion people, it sustains the world's second-largest economy while sheltering over 2,000 nature reserves. This documentary spotlights China's natural heritage for tomorrow's possibilities.

programme.title: Taohuawu New Year's Painting
programme.desc: Taohuawu New Year woodblock prints, originating from Suzhou, are iconic symbols of Chinese folk art. These vibrant prints, traditionally displayed during Chinese New Year, depict auspicious scenes, deities, and daily life, embodying wishes for prosperity and happiness. Explore the intricate carving and printing techniques that bring these colorful cultural treasures to life.

programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique \"rock rhyme\" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: The Dynasty of Oracle Bones Ep.3
programme.desc: Over 3000 years ago, inscriptions were made into the bones of oxen and the undersides of turtle shells for the purpose of divination. Broken down into six comprehensive episodes, this series will enlighten you on the Shang Dynasty when they first appeared, as well as their role in the formation of Chinese writing.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Dance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this episode, our host “Uncle Hanzi” travels to Chaonan in Shantou to explore the story of a family devoted to the tradition of Yingge dance. Centered around inheritor Hong Shaohua, the story unfolds through his father’s dedication, his daughter’s passion, and his apprentices’ enthusiasm—showcasing how this centuries-old folk art continues to thrive in the modern world.

programme.title: Treasures and Masks Ep.1
programme.desc: A fantastical encounter lies at the heart of this documentary: a meeting between the bronze figures of Sanxingdui and the mask of the great Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun. ‘Treasures and Masks’ represents a cutting-edge bridging of ancient Chinese and Egyptian civilizations that has to be seen to be believed.

programme.desc: In 1962, the people of the small town of Hanford, California, lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.desc: A mother of two vanishes after a shopping trip. Her body is discovered a month later. Witnesses say they saw the victim being forced into a car by an unknown person.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: A woman's death in Pennsylvania triggers a homicide investigation into another woman's death in North Carolina. The similarities in the cases were striking, and examiners must determine if the suspect's story about accidental drowning is all wet.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police were puzzled by an obscure print found at a crime scene where one man had been killed, and two teenage girls were seriously injured. Neither of the girls could identify their attacker.

programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home, and his ex-wife has a perfect alibi. To determine the time of death, investigators need to know when the victim ate his last meal. An endocrinologist, a forensic botanist, and a short-order cook answer their question.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly takes center stage for “Home Week” as he shares a deeply personal dish from his Long Island upbringing: spaghetti with white clam sauce. Drawing on childhood memories of digging for clams in the mudflats of Port Jefferson Station, Clinton walks through a simple yet flavorful recipe using fresh little neck clams, garlic-infused olive oil, white wine, and parsley. As he cooks, the hosts—Carla Hall and Michael Symon—swap stories about growing up, working in restaurants, and stepping outside their comfort zones, with Clinton reflecting on his journey from introversion to becoming a television personality. The episode balances cooking with lively debate, including a spirited discussion about oversized restaurant menus and the etiquette of bringing your own hot sauce to a meal. Michael delivers a passionate rant about seasoning, while Carla offers thoughtful insights on culinary authenticity. The trio’s chemistry shines through playful teasing and shared appreciation for food that tells a story. As the pasta comes together, Clinton emphasizes technique—like gently infusing garlic at low heat and using reserved clam juice for depth of flavor—resulting in a dish that is both accessible and impressive. The episode wraps with the hosts tasting the final product, praising its balance and simplicity. A fun game segment, “Clinton or Clam,” adds humor, followed by fan mail and a giveaway announcement featuring a signed cookbook. The show closes on a warm, communal note, celebrating food, friendship, and the stories behind every dish.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode, Carla Hall assumes the role of Queen of Halloween and welcomes Clinton Kelly and Michael Symon for a spooky celebration. Guest Jeanette Donnarumma returns to demonstrate crafty crescent roll appetizers including coffin pizza pockets, mummy dogs wrapped in crescent dough, and spider bites. The hosts also create Halloween mocktails like the Purple Potion Punch and HALL-o-Ween Hot Honey Punch. The Crafty Lumberjacks join to showcase easy party crafts including pumpkin photo frames, witch wine bottles, glue gun candelabras, temporary tattoo candles, and pumpkins wrapped in festive tights. Recipes featured include Pumpkin Cheesecake Crescent Moons and various appetizers perfect for Halloween gatherings.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Carla Hall takes center stage during “Home Week” as she introduces Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly to a nostalgic Nashville staple: the hot fish sandwich. Drawing from her childhood memories, Carla explains that unlike the city’s famous hot chicken, this dish is all about being served piping hot straight from the oil rather than spicy. As she prepares cornmeal-crusted catfish, she shares stories of visiting local spots like Ed’s Fish, where the sandwich was a simple, affordable treat enjoyed on Fridays and often eaten outdoors. The hosts dive into a lively conversation about how Nashville has transformed over the years, balancing its old-school charm with its modern “Nash Vegas” energy, while also reflecting on how food traditions connect to community and shared experiences. Carla walks through the cooking process step-by-step, offering practical tips on frying, seasoning, and building the perfect sandwich with white bread, yellow mustard, hot sauce, pickles, and onions. Once assembled, the sandwich sparks an enthusiastic reaction, with the hosts praising its comforting, craveable simplicity. The conversation expands into broader themes about slowing down, engaging with others, and the lost art of waiting for food. The episode continues with fan mail, where the hosts share personal stories about Easter traditions, hidden talents, and the nuances of giving honest feedback. A playful hometown trivia game rounds things out, followed by a humorous and eclectic giveaway from Carla’s own closet. The episode closes on a high note, celebrating the joy of food, memory, and connection

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon welcome Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli, the chef-owners behind the celebrated New York restaurant Don Angie, for a lively episode dedicated to Italian American comfort food. The conversation begins with admiration for the restaurant’s iconic lasagna before shifting to the main event: a deeply flavorful, “life-changing” meatball recipe inspired by a blend of both chefs’ grandmothers’ traditions. As Angie and Scott walk through their process, they share chef-driven techniques like using a milk-soaked panade for moisture, puréed onions for even flavor distribution, and roasted garlic to avoid harsh raw bites. The hosts jump in with questions and personal anecdotes, sparking a broader discussion about Italian versus Italian American cooking, rule-breaking in the kitchen, and regional food identity—from Cleveland to New York. The group also plays a spirited round of “Discuss,” debating topics like garlic usage, cheese on seafood, and proper spaghetti etiquette, leading to humorous and opinionated exchanges. Along the way, they highlight the philosophy behind Don Angie’s food: bold, unapologetic flavors built on cheese, garlic, and tradition—without strict adherence to old-world rules. As the meatballs finish baking, they’re tossed in a simple, bright tomato sauce and served family-style, earning rave reviews from the hosts for their rich texture and layered flavor. The episode wraps with a fan giveaway of the chefs’ cookbook and a final celebration of Italian American cuisine, emphasizing creativity, collaboration, and the joy of cooking without limits.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon take on the ultimate comfort food by each creating their own version of a grilled cheese sandwich, showcasing three distinct styles that range from classic to elevated. Michael leads with a rich and decadent Croque Madame, complete with a homemade mornay sauce, gruyère, ham, and a perfectly cooked egg on top, sharing tips on building flavor and texture through technique. Carla follows with a Southern-inspired twist, hollowing out a brioche bun to stuff it with pimento cheese and tangy chow chow pickles, emphasizing balance and texture in every bite. Clinton rounds things out with a fan-inspired take on a classic grilled cheese, combining American, cheddar, and gruyère cheeses on rye bread, using mayonnaise for an evenly crisp, golden exterior. Throughout the episode, the trio trades stories, jokes, and cooking insights, debating everything from sandwich ratios to restaurant culture. They later shift into a lively “overrated vs. underrated” game, diving into food trends, brunch culture, and even aging, blending humor with candid reflections. The episode wraps with a fan giveaway and appreciation for sponsors, leaving viewers inspired to experiment with their own grilled cheese creations at home.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly, Carla Hall, and Michael Symon welcome legendary pitmaster Melissa Cookston for a lively, flavor-packed episode centered around Mexican-inspired smoked chicken wings. The conversation kicks off with playful banter about grilling, live-fire cooking, and Melissa’s impressive barbecue credentials, setting the stage for a masterclass in flavor. Melissa walks the hosts through her approach to wings, emphasizing dry rubs over heavy sauces and showcasing a spice blend inspired by her travels to Mexico, featuring garlic, onion, smoked Hungarian paprika, ancho chili powder, cumin, and oregano. Along the way, the group dives into deeper cooking philosophy—trusting your instincts, cooking with your senses, and understanding that great barbecue is about feel as much as technique. Melissa shares insights on smoking temperatures, wood choices, and why over-smoking can ruin a dish, comparing it to over-salting. The energy stays high as Clinton hilariously spirals into wing-induced chaos, while Carla and Michael debate everything from condiments to air fryers. The episode also highlights Melissa’s new cookbook, Fanning the Flames, described as a love letter to her global culinary travels and the people who inspired her. After cooking, the group digs into the wings, followed by a round of “Chew It or Screw It” and fan mail, blending humor with heartfelt moments. The episode wraps with giveaways and a celebration of community, creativity, and the joy of cooking with fire.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: In this heartfelt Mother’s Day episode of Chewed Up, Michael Symon, Carla Hall, and Clinton Kelly reflect on the women who shaped them while Carla leads the kitchen with a show-stopping mimosa brioche French toast topped with frangipane. Inspired by her mother’s love of simple breakfast classics like pancakes and French toast, Carla elevates the dish into a baked, brunch-worthy centerpiece featuring brioche, apricot jam, almond-rich frangipane, and a champagne-orange glaze. As the dish comes together, the hosts share nostalgic stories about their childhoods—from weeknight dinners and Sunday sauces to special outings at places like Bob Evans and Chinese restaurants—highlighting how food connects to family memories. The conversation flows with humor and warmth, touching on generational differences in cooking habits and dining culture. Once the dish is baked to golden perfection, the trio digs in, praising its rich texture and balance of flavors, with Carla’s creative twist winning everyone over. The episode continues with playful segments like “What Would Mom Say,” where the hosts share funny and revealing lessons from their mothers, followed by fan mail and a casual food discussion. The show wraps with a giveaway of Carla’s personal artwork and a sincere tribute to moms everywhere, celebrating the love, lessons, and meals that define family traditions.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly takes the lead in the kitchen as he prepares a nostalgic Quiche Lorraine inspired by his mother, making the case for a simple yet meaningful Mother’s Day brunch made at home. As he walks through the process—layering raw onions, crispy bacon, and a rich egg-and-cream custard into a par-baked crust—Carla Hall and Michael Symon chime in with their own takes on brunch traditions, ingredient preferences, and the beauty of regional cuisine. The trio shares laughs over everything from vintage baby names to the infamous “Real Men Don’t Eat Quiche” era, using humor to dismantle outdated ideas around food and masculinity. Along the way, they highlight the importance of texture and balance, celebrating the silky, slightly jiggly custard as the hallmark of a perfectly baked quiche. A fan interaction segment adds a personal touch, with a “Fan of the Day” selected for a custom video message, reinforcing the show’s community-driven spirit. Once the quiche comes out of the oven, the hosts dig in, offering real-time reactions and thoughtful observations about flavor, technique, and versatility—debating whether quiche is best suited for brunch, lunch, or dinner. The episode wraps with a heartfelt nod to mothers everywhere and a reminder that sometimes the simplest dishes, made with care, are the most memorable.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon takes a nostalgic trip back to his early culinary days, recreating an OG state fair classic—steak on a stick—while Carla Hall and Clinton Kelly dive into a lively, humor-filled conversation about food, memories, and the joy of eating with your hands. Using flank steak, Michael walks through his simple but flavor-packed marinade of soy sauce, Worcestershire, Dijon, and spices, explaining the importance of cutting against the grain and letting the meat soak overnight for maximum tenderness. As the skewers hit the grill, the hosts debate whether food is inherently more fun on a stick, with Clinton firmly in the “yes” camp and Michael offering a more chef-driven perspective. The conversation branches into strong opinions on kebabs, with the trio agreeing that mixing vegetables and meat on the same skewer is a mistake, leading to soggy results. Along the way, they share personal anecdotes—from Carla being mistaken for Tracee Ellis Ross to Michael’s frustrations with diners’ rigid expectations around classic dishes—highlighting the humor and unpredictability of food culture. The episode wraps with the hosts tasting the finished steak, praising its bold flavor and simplicity, while also announcing a fan giveaway tied to Michael’s Simply Symon show. As always, the group signs off with their signature blend of warmth, wit, and encouragement to keep cooking and having fun in the kitchen.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Carla Hall takes the lead in the kitchen as she introduces a playful and unexpected dish: fried Kool-Aid, inspired by nostalgic state fair treats from her childhood. As she walks through the process of making the vibrant red dough using Kool-Aid powder, flour, sugar, and a leavening agent, Clinton Kelly reacts with skepticism while Michael Symon shares his own less-than-great experience trying the dish at a fair. The conversation quickly turns humorous as Carla recounts a bizarre childhood memory of having a runny nose at the fair, prompting playful teasing from the group. As the dough is fried into donut hole-like bites, the hosts discuss technique, including how the dough naturally flips in hot oil and how to tell when it’s perfectly cooked. Carla elevates the dish by tossing the warm bites in lemon sugar and offering a Kool-Aid glaze for dipping, balancing sweetness with a bright citrus note. Once tasted, both Clinton and Michael are pleasantly surprised, praising the light texture and more refined flavor compared to traditional fair versions. The episode transitions into a lively fan mail segment where the hosts debate their least favorite vegetables and share personal preferences, followed by a special “fan of the day” moment celebrating a crew member’s mother’s birthday with jokes and a spontaneous song from Clinton. The episode wraps with the hosts encouraging viewers to engage with the show and teasing future fun.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly takes on a true first in his cooking career by attempting homemade corn dogs without any prior test run, bringing a mix of nerves and excitement to the kitchen as Michael Symon and Carla Hall cheer him on. Inspired by a popular recipe from Natasha’s Kitchen, Clinton walks through the batter and frying process in real time, navigating hot oil, technique adjustments, and plenty of playful banter. As the trio discusses their favorite fair foods—from funnel cake to childhood carnival memories—the conversation veers into hilarious territory, including rollercoaster mishaps and food-related regrets. Despite the pressure, Clinton successfully executes the corn dogs, achieving a golden, airy batter that impresses both Carla and Michael. The tasting confirms the dish as a win, with praise for its balanced sweetness, texture, and classic flavor. The episode also features a “Fan of the Day” segment, celebrating Charlene from New York with a personalized shoutout, along with a quick fan mail discussion about music preferences while cooking, revealing everything from Judy Garland to Metallica and R.E.M. The episode wraps on a high note, with Clinton’s confidence restored, the group celebrating a successful first attempt, and the hosts encouraging viewers to engage, subscribe, and bring the fun into their own kitchens.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Michael Symon takes over the kitchen to teach essential knife skills and prep techniques that can instantly improve anyone’s cooking game. Joined by Clinton Kelly and Carla Hall, the trio dives into the importance of sharp knives, proper sharpening methods, and why most home cooks only really need three knives in their kitchen arsenal. Michael demonstrates how to properly hold a chef’s knife, sharpen blades using a wheel sharpener, and explains the difference between honing and sharpening, while Clinton enthusiastically jumps in with detailed play-by-play commentary and cooking science facts. Carla keeps the conversation lively with jokes about Michael’s long-winded explanations and practical reminders about time-saving kitchen habits. Throughout the episode, Michael walks viewers through slicing celery, chiffonading herbs, and properly dicing onions while explaining the safest and most efficient cutting techniques. The hosts also passionately debate cutting boards, with Michael launching into a hilarious rant against plastic, ceramic, and glass boards in favor of traditional wood boards. Humor runs throughout the segment, including a conversation about Ginsu knives, microplastics, and Clinton’s grammar-school definition of “interjections.” The episode wraps with the “Fan of the Day” segment, where Lysa from Seattle wins a personalized video message from the hosts, followed by a final round of playful insults and banter before signing off.

programme.title: Chewed Up
programme.desc: Carla Hall shares her ultimate biscuit-making secrets while teaching two different techniques for creating perfect homemade biscuits. Joined by Michael Symon and Clinton Kelly, Carla walks through her trusted biscuit recipe while revealing the small adjustments and baking tricks she has collected over years of cooking, tasting, and learning from other biscuit makers. The conversation centers around how technique can completely transform the same recipe, as Carla demonstrates both drop biscuits baked in muffin tins and laminated layered biscuits made through folding and stacking dough. Along the way, the hosts discuss the importance of cold butter, the role of steam in creating flaky layers, and why full-fat buttermilk makes a major difference in texture and tenderness. Michael and Clinton enthusiastically jump into the science behind baking while keeping the conversation playful, debating butter pockets, crispy edges, and the superiority of muffin-tin stuffing. Carla also shares clever practical tricks, including using oil instead of excess flour on the work surface and flipping biscuit dough for better height and rise. The trio reflects on how cooking competition shows continue to teach even experienced chefs new techniques, reinforcing the episode’s theme that cooking is a constant learning process. After pulling both styles of biscuits from the oven, the hosts compare the textures and flavors of each version while slathering them with butter, jam, and honey. The episode wraps with Carol from Columbus, Ohio being selected as the “Fan of the Day,” earning a personalized message from the hosts before everyone signs off stuffed and satisfied.

programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with 6LACK. Born in Baltimore and raised in Atlanta, 6LACK grew up around music from the start - his father owned a recording studio, and he was already stepping into the booth by age four. After cutting his teeth as a teenage battle rapper, he broke through in 2016 with his debut album Free 6lack, which spawned the Grammy-nominated single "PRBLMS" and established the introspective, emotionally direct sound he's known for. His follow-up, East Atlanta Love Letter, debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200, and his most recent album, Since I Have a Lover, earned him a Grammy nomination for Best Progressive RB Album. Along the way, he's collaborated with everyone from J. Cole and Lil Baby to Elton John and Gorillaz. A decade into his career, 6LACK joins Joel in the Artist Friendly studio to open up about how he has spent the last few years simplifying his life — cutting out excess, opportunists, and old habits — confronting the ego he didn't know he had, and learning what it actually means to build a life around what matters most.

Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: The Kennedy Half-Century
programme.desc: The Kennedy Half-Century chronicles the enduring impact of John F. Kennedy's life and policies on the U.S. presidency since JFK's tragic death in 1963. From Lyndon Johnson's Great Society to Ronald Reagan's tax cuts and Cold War strategies, from Bill Clinton's infatuation with Kennedy to the similarities between JFK and Barack Obama in the 2008 presidential campaign, The Kennedy Half-Century explores the legacy of JFK over the past fifty years. Based on the new book by Larry Sabato, the compelling one hour documentary features archival photos of Kennedy's assassination and funeral, historic moments and interviews with major political and media figures, including Bob Schieffer, Ron Reagan Jr., Kathleen Kennedy Townsend, Ari Fleischer, James Carville, Julian Bond, Andrew Bell and Larry Sabato, among others.

programme.title: Perfect 36: When Women Won the Vote
programme.desc: In July of 1920, all eyes were on Nashville, Tennessee as anti- and pro-suffragists each fought for their vision of a socially evolving United States. PERFECT 36: WHEN WOMEN WON THE VOTE chronicles the dramatic vote to ratify the 19th amendment granting women the right to vote, and the years of debate about women's suffrage that preceded it.On July 17, 1920, Carrie Chapman Catt, President of the National American Woman Suffrage Association, arrived to spend a few days in Nashville. She was traveling on the heels of Tennessee Governor A.H. Roberts' announcement of a special session of the state legislature, called at the urging of President Woodrow Wilson. One more state needed to ratify the proposed amendment, and that duty rested solely on the shoulders of Tennessee. Catt's few days dragged into weeks at her headquarters in the Hermitage Hotel, where pro- and anti- suffragists continued to clash in what came to be known as the War of the Roses. Those in favor sported yellow roses, while those against wore red. On the sweltering day of August 18, 1920, the House convened. After two consecutive 48-48 outcomes to table the resolution, it was put to a vote. The votes were coming in neck and neck. At the last minute, 24-year-old freshman representative Harry Burn recalled a letter from his mother received that morning, urging him to, be a good boy and grant women the right to vote. In spite of wearing a red rose, Burn swung his vote, making Tennessee the deciding 36th state to enable passage of the 19th Amendment, and thereby granting women their Constitutional right.

programme.title: Civil War: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Sherman is defeated in Georgia . . . But then defeats the Confederates at Jonesboro and continues his March to the Sea, dealing a psychological blow to the Confederacy and a stunning conclusion to the Western Campaign . . . In November, President Lincoln defeats his opponent McClellan in a landslide election . . . The 13th Amendment abolishing slavery is passed by the House on January 31, 1865. Six weeks later, Abraham Lincoln gives his Second Inaugural Address . . . More than 750,000 Americans, Union and Confederate, perished in the conflict. In the smoldering ash of war, the nation has survived.

programme.title: Civil War: The Untold Story
programme.desc: 1860 presidential election of anti-slavery candidate Abraham Lincoln . . . Thirteen states from the South secede and form the Confederate States of America, led by President Jefferson Davis . . . 1862 Union forces led by General Ulysses S. Egal ob Cocktailbar, Restaurant oder private Arbeitsvermittlung - Thomas hat schon alles durch. Er lebte auch schon für vier Jahre in der Türkei. Die Kandidat:innen sind gerührt und den Tränen nahe, denn sie haben Botschaften von ihren Liebsten bekommen. Egal ob Videobotschaft oder Fax - die Freude ist groß! Die Bewohner:innen leben nämlich bereits seit 40 Tagen im Big Brother-Haus. Lisa ist traurig, da sie keine Osterbotschaft von ihren Engsten erhalten hat. Dabei würde sie so gern wissen, wie es ihrer Familie geht. Doch am liebsten will sie wissen, ob es ihrem Freund gut geht.

programme.title: Ostergeschenk von Big Brother I Tag 41 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Bisher kennen wir Ali als den lustigen Big Brother-Kandidaten. Doch hinter dieser Facette steckt auch eine andere Seite. Ali erzählt erstmals über seine verstorbene große Schwester und wie seine Familie darunter leidet. Big Brother hat ein großes Ostergeschenk für die Bewohner:innen: ein Osterfest! Das Fest wird im "reichen" Bereich stattfinden und jeder muss bei der Vorbereitung mithelfen. Alle sind fleißig dabei das Fest vorzubereiten. Jerry wurde erzählt, dass Jeannine vor dem Einzug in das Big Brother-Haus etwas mit Thomas gehabt haben soll. Er konfrontiert sie daraufhin mit dieser Information. Laut Jeannine sei das eine Lüge und Thomas nur ein guter Freund.

programme.title: Spiel mit der Wahrheit: Woche 7 fordert Nerven I 7 Weekly Live Show Staffel 5
programme.desc: Woche 7 im Big Brother-Haus – und nichts bleibt unausgesprochen. Ehrliche Worte, harte Konfrontationen und ein Spiel, das Grenzen testet. In der siebten Live-Show wird es emotional und unangenehm ehrlich. Wer hält dem Druck stand?

programme.title: Zu Besuch in Heikos Heimat I Tag 42 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Heiko wuchs in Teipiz in Sachsen mit seinen Geschwistern auf. In genau diesen Ort wurde ein Ausflug gemacht, um von seinen Brüdern mehr über den Big Brother-Kandidaten zu erfahren. Heikos Bruder ist jedoch nicht so gut auf ihn zu sprechen. Thomas gibt seinen Mitbewohner:innen heute etwas Geschichtsunterricht. Das Thema: Deutschland vor der Wende. Er erzählt den anderen von dem Mauerbau und von Fluchtversuchen, die gravierende Folgen hatten. Vor zwei Tagen wurde Sascha aus dem Haus gerufen. Er sollte bei einer vermeindlichen Challenge antreten. Anstatt Sascha kehrt heute Saschas eineiiger Zwilling zurück ins das Big Brother-Haus, um die Kandidat:innen auszutrixen.

programme.title: Jeannine in 13 Metern Tiefe I Tag 43 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Bei der heutigen Challenge muss sich Jeannine auf die Suche nach der Flaschenpost begeben. Doch dafür muss sie tief tauchen. In einem Tank, in dem sich 21 Millionen Liter Wasser befinden und der 13 Meter in die Tiefe geht, muss sie die Flaschenpost finden. Doreen ist die Neue im Big Brother-Haus und die anderen nehmen sie erst mal unter die Lupe. Am Zaun unterhalten sich die Kandidat:innen über die Neue und sind nicht gerade gut auf sie zu sprechen. Besonders Nicole und Franco haben was über sie anzumerken. Doreen gibt Jeannine und Nicole heute einen Einblick in ihre harte Jugend. Sie lebte bereits im Alter von elf Jahren auf der Straße und kam mit 13 Jahren in ein Heim. Detailliert möchte sie jedoch nicht über ihre Erfahrungen sprechen.

programme.title: Überfall auf den reichen Bereich I Tag 44 Staffel 5
programme.desc: Doreen sprach letztens bereits davon, dass sie eine harte Jugend hatte und sie in einem Heim lebte. Heute erzählt sie den anderen von dem schlechten Verhältnis zu ihrer Mutter. Diese soll eine Egoistin sein und ihren Vater immer betrogen haben. Nicole und Lisa sind von ihren Teamkollegen genervt! Ständig sei die Klohbrille nass und schmutzig und sie sein diejenigen, die es putzen müssen. Die Verdächtigen werden daraufhin zur Rede gestellt. Die Bewohner:innen bereiten sich für die Operation "Stürmung des reichen Bereichs" vor. Sie sind schwarz gekleidet und auch ihre Gesichter sind bedeckt, damit sie unerkannt bleiben. Ali wird sogar von seinen Soldaten mit "Waffen" ausgestattet.

programme.title: Singapur extrem: Todesstrafe und Rikscha-Wahnsinn!
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich in Singapur mit Tourguide Suzy. Zuerst soll die Metropole auf einer Bootsrundfahrt erkundet werden. Schnell kommt es zu einem äußerst heiklen Thema: Singapurs Gesetze und... die Todesstrafe! (S5 E17)

programme.title: Speedboot-Abzocke auf Barbados?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens verbringen einige Tage auf Barbados, doch statt Ruhe will Robert sofort Action. Beim geplanten Speedboot-Trip läuft vieles anders als erwartet. Seit über zehn Jahren zeigt RTLZWEI ihr Leben zwischen Luxusalltag und exklusiven Events. (S6 E02)

programme.title: Überraschung: Robert Geiss kauft heimlich ein Boot!
programme.desc: Es muss ein Boot her! Und das am besten sofort! Robert Geiss weiß auch schon ganz genau, wo er eins bekommt. Also auf zum Bootsladen. Doch Carmen Geiss traut ihren Augen kaum... wieso steht auf einem der Boote bereits Roberts Name? (S6 E03)

programme.title: Bootsdrama und heiße Cheerleader?!
programme.desc: tress pur! Robert und Carmen Geiss machen mit ihren Kindern und dem neuen Boot eine Spritztour. Doch plötzlich passiert es... Robert fährt auf eine Sandbank! Um sie herum nur Felsen und flaches Wasser. (S6 E04)

programme.title: Horror-Trip nach St. Barth!
programme.desc: Auch in Florida ist das Wetter schließlich manchmal schlecht – und so etwas kommt bei den Geissens gar nicht in die Tüte! Daher verlassen Carmen und Robert Miami in Richtung Karibik. (S6 E05)

programme.title: Romantik in der Karibik: Carmen Geiss schwebt auf
programme.desc: Die Geissens finden in der Karibik eine einsame Insel. Carmen Geiss überlegt kurzerhand, einfach mit der Yacht abzuhauen... Aber dann kommt alles anders - denn Robert hat eine Überraschung für sie! Carmen schwebt sofort auf Wolke 7. (S6 E06)

programme.title: Chaos pur: Reinhold Geiss bringt alle auf die Palme!
programme.desc: Robert und sein Vater Reinhold Geiss waren mit den Kindern "angeln". Leider ohne Erfolg. Die schnelle Lösung: ein Fisch vom Fischmarkt. Doch Carmen Geiss kann man nicht so leicht täuschen... (S6 E08)

programme.title: Auf den Spuren von Jennifer Lopez und Enrique
programme.desc: Die Geissens treffen sich heute mit einem Kapitän, der ihnen das Gebiet rund um Miami zeigt. Doch Carmen Geiss' Stimmung ist direkt zu Beginn schon auf dem Tiefpunkt. Zum Glück ist für Ablenkung gesorgt: Ist das etwa die Villa von Jennifer Lopez? (S6 E09)

programme.title: Auf Wolke 7: Robert Geiss übertrifft sich selbst!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss verbringt die Weihnachtszeit in New York! Zuerst steht natürlich Shoppen bei Macy's auf dem Programm. Im Anschluss hat Robert Geiss noch etwas ganz Besonderes organisiert: einen Helikopterflug über die Lichter der Stadt. (S6 E10)

programme.title: Absolut wild: Reinhold Geiss riskiert sein Leben!
programme.desc: Familie Geiss erkundet den Everglades-Nationalpark in Florida. Doch dort wimmelt es nur so von wilden Alligatoren! Die möchten natürlich auch gefüttert werden! (S6 E11)

programme.title: WOW! Carmen Geiss lässt heiße Poolbilder machen...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat eine ganz besondere Überraschung geplant! Und dafür macht sie sich ausnahmsweise sogar die Haare nass! Unsere Lieblingsmillionärin möchte heiße Pool-Bilder für ihren Göttergatten Robert Geiss schießen lassen. (S6 E12)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens besuchen den Freizeitpark WonderWorks in Orlando. Erst testen sie einen Hurrikan-Simulator, dann geht es zum Indoor-Sky-Diving. Während die Kinder vorlegen, wagt Carmen den Sprung in den Windkanal. (S6 E14)

programme.title: Scharfes Fotoshooting: Carmen Geiss posiert mit
programme.desc: Heute steht das große Roberto-Geissini-Shooting an - und Robert Geiss hat diesmal richtig dick aufgetragen: bunte Harleys, heiße Models und eine brandneue Kollektion. (S6 E15)

programme.title: Inflagranti erwischt?!
programme.desc: Das gibt Ärger. Die Kinder und Robert haben Carmen Geiss' Wagen "verschönert". Noch bevor Robert Geiss die Situation retten kann, kommt sie plötzlich um die Ecke. Zum Glück hat sie kaum Zeit, sauer zu werden - denn es geht direkt ins Tonstudio. (S6 E16)

programme.title: Mega-Fail beim Poker Run in Miami!
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss wurden zum Speedboot-Event Poker Run in Miami eingeladen. Die Mission: Mit ihrer Donzi von Spot zu Spot fahren, an jeder Station eine Spielkarte sammeln und am Ende mit dem besten Pokerblatt gewinnen. (S6 E17)

programme.title: Die Geissens
programme.desc: Die Geissens starten eine abenteuerliche Fahrt mit der Donzi. Damit alles gut geht, haben sie einen erfahrenen Kapitän mit an Bord, denn überall lauern Sandbänke. Und dann passiert das Unvermeidbare: Robert und Carmen Geiss sitzen plötzlich fest! (S6 E18)

programme.title: Horror im Keller: Carmen Geiss ist plötzlich
programme.desc: Robert Geiss macht ordentlich Dampf und schickt Carmen Geiss in den Keller, um die Koffer zu holen. Überall warten Klamottenberge darauf, verstaut zu werden. Aber wo bleibt Carmen? (S6 E19)

programme.title: Nichts geht mehr! Totalschaden bei Geissens'
programme.desc: Nach der Rückkehr aus Miami ist es in Monaco eisig kalt und das totale Chaos bricht aus! In der Tiefgarage steht sie kurz vorm Nervenzusammenbruch - kein einziges der heißgeliebten Luxusautos will anspringen! Nur der Maserati läuft… (S6 E20)

programme.title: Hat Robert Geiss heimlich eine Yacht gekauft?
programme.desc: Familie Geiss fliegt mit dem Helikopter von St. Tropez nach Monaco – und weiter nach Alicante. Dort wartet schon Robert Geiss' neues Projekt: ein riesiges Luxusboot. Doch auf der Yacht wird geschraubt, gehämmert und Möbel werden verschoben. (S6 E21)

programme.title: Couch über Bord: Carmen Geiss flippt aus!
programme.desc: Eigentlich wollten Carmen und Robert Geiss in Alicante die Renovierungsfortschritte auf ihrer neuen Yacht inspizieren. Doch plötzlich treibt Carmens Couch einfach im Hafen! Während Robert das Ganze gelassen sieht, ist Carmen kurz vorm Explodieren. (S7 E01)

programme.title: Hotel-Drama: Robert Geiss rastet aus!
programme.desc: Die Geissens sind spontan nach Obertauern geflogen und haben sich die Präsidentensuite in einem luxuriösen Hotel gebucht. Davina möchte Freiraum und bucht heimlich eine eigene Suite. Das ist nicht die einzige Sache, die Robert in den Wahnsinn treibt. (S16 E03)

programme.title: Segway-Action im Schnee & Krasser Sturz
programme.desc: In Obertauern hat Robert Geiss mal wieder eine besondere Überraschung für seine Familie geplant: Er möchte Segway im Schnee fahren! Alle sind von Roberts Idee begeistert, doch dann kommt es plötzlich zu einem gefährlichen Sturz... (S16 E04)

programme.title: Shania ziert sich beim Modeln
programme.desc: Shania Geiss möchte unbedingt Model werden Sie bekommt Unterstützung vom internationalen Topmodel Papis Loveday. Der ist hellauf begeistert von ihrem Look, allerdings passt ihm ihre Einstellung gar nicht - und das lässt er Shania spüren. (S16 E15)

programme.title: Das Neue Zuhause der Geissens
programme.desc: Carmen überbringt den Töchtern die Nachricht, dass sie sich ein neues Apartment gekauft haben. Bei der Begehung sind sie noch etwas voreingenommen, doch als sie erfahren, dass sie an den gesamten Umbauarbeiten teilhaben dürfen, sind sie überzeugt. (S19 E03)

programme.title: Die Tattoo-Intrige
programme.desc: Nach einem kurzen Abstecher zum Harley Davidson Store seilen sich die Frauen der Familie von Robert ab – unter dem Vorwand einer Shoppingtour. Was er noch nicht ahnt ist, dass sie sich ein gemeinsames Mutter-Tochter-Tattoo stechen lassen. (S19 E06)

programme.title: Carmen, die Kampfmaschine
programme.desc: Die Schwestern bekommen eine private Judostunde, um ihre Fähigkeiten im Bereich der Selbstverteidigung auszubauen. Doch womit wohl keiner gerechnet hat: Carmen ein absoluter Vollprofi im Kampfsport! (S19 E10)

programme.title: Trüffeljagd in Kroatien
programme.desc: In Kroatien steht bei den Geissens ein extravagantes Dinner mit Freunden an. Dafür hat sich Robert einen ganz besonderen Plan überlegt: Er möchte den Trüffel für das Essen selber sammeln! Ob die Trüffeljagd wohl erfolgreich sein wird? (S19 E12)

programme.title: Girl Is Mocked for Thrift Shopping
programme.desc: Carly, a girl from a struggling family, is rejected by a wealthy cheer captain. Guided by influencer Anna McNulty and her dad, she trains via YouTube, forms her own team, and wins the top prize.

programme.title: Entire School Sick From Evil Principal's Secret
programme.desc: When Mateo and other students collapse, Ernie, Callie, and Jackie investigate. They discover the principal is taking bribes to hide heavy metal water poisoning. The trio exposes the truth, saving the school.

programme.title: Mom Doesn't Know Nanny Is Daughter
programme.desc: Resentful Britney becomes Andrea's nanny to secretly ruin her life, believing Andrea abandoned her. She discovers the heartbreaking truth of her adoption, leading to a tearful family reconciliation

programme.title: Famous Gamer Won't Show His Ear on Camera
programme.desc: Famous family gamer FGTeeV's Vincent Carter reveals the decades-long bullying and shame over his ear condition that he hid from millions of fans, finding healing through faith and family.

programme.title: Mean Girls Make Fun of Small Gymnast
programme.desc: Struggling with the loss of her mother, gymnast Ava faces mental blocks and bullies at regionals. With support from her father and Salish Matter, she learns that true victory is never giving up.

programme.title: Teen Interns With Billionaire on Spring Break
programme.desc: A broke teen lands a spring break job with a reclusive billionaire, but risks losing his girlfriend and family chasing wealth, until his boss's regrets teach him what truly matters.

programme.title: Mom Leaves Family After Winning the Lottery
programme.desc: A hardworking mom secretly wins $10 million, gives her family spending money and disappears, letting them learn through chaos, bad choices, and consequences why her rules always mattered.

programme.title: She Hid Her Face for 10 Years
programme.desc: Mira hides facial burn scars behind a mask, while pageant queen Aubri hides under heavy makeup. The two form an unlikely bond, choosing authenticity over parental pressure and finding acceptance

programme.title: 12-Year-Old Knocks Out A Pro Fighter
programme.desc: After his mother abandons him to reform school, young Mike Tyson is discovered by trainer Cus D'Amato. Cus and Camille provide a stable home, transforming the troubled teen into a boxing champion.

programme.title: Teacher's Secret Past Gets Her Fired, What Happens Next Is Shocking
programme.desc: A vengeful ex leaks teacher Katy's old photos, getting her fired. After Katy's advice helps a student escape a toxic romance, the student's lawyer mom helps Katy regain her job and stop the harasser.

programme.title: Student Shamed for Being a Little Person
programme.desc: Lucas, a student with dwarfism, faces bullying and social isolation. By introducing "tactile learning," he improves his classmates' grades, saves the school's funding, and finally finds a true community.

programme.title: Students Find Out Teacher Is War Hero on Veteran's Day
programme.desc: Arrogant student Caleb mocks a woman for parking in a veteran's spot. He later discovers she is "Halo Harry," the war hero who saved his father's life, leading him to redefine what a hero truly is.

programme.title: Controlling Dad Won't Let Teen Socialize
programme.desc: Damien, a star athlete, ditches his strict father for a flashy manager who promises riches. After losing focus and being betrayed, Damien returns to his roots to reclaim his game and future.

programme.title: Fake Friends Bully ARFID Girl for Labubus
programme.desc: Hannah, a girl with a severe food phobia, is bullied by peers and her own teacher. After trying to buy friendship with toys, she exposes her teacher as an online troll and finally makes real friends.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Maja und Rainer sind gemeinsam in der Bahn unterwegs als Majas Handy klingelt und der Anrufer von ihr Telefonsex verlangt. Rainer ist empört. Maja bleibt freundlich und versucht zu helfen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Richard Wildfeuer möchte 200 Euro bei seiner Bank abheben. Fräulein Klinger weist höflich auf die Turbulenzen an den internationalen Finanzmärkten hin, aber Herr Wildfeuer besteht auf die Auszahlung. Schließlich einigt man sich darauf, dass die Kollegin Frau Birkner zunächst einmal ein bisschen nett zu Herr Wildfeuer ist.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Promi-Luder Onka zeigt ihre Bandidos, Ute freut sich auf den Aufguss in der Sauna und Diktator Kim Young Il macht sich mit Facebook vertraut – „gefällt mir“.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Katja beklagt sich bei ihrer Freundin Nadine über ihre miserable finanzielle Lage als Alleinerziehende. Aber zum Glück hat sie einen lukrativen Nebenjob als „Kindertaxi“, bei dem sie Kinder auf dem Rollbrett ihres Kinderwagens transportiert. Außerdem reklamiert eine unzufriedene Kundin ihren Einkauf in einer Buchhandlung. Die Verkäuferin ist zunächst skeptisch, muss aber nach einem Blick in das Buch zugeben, dass die Geschichte wirr und die Hauptfigur flach ist.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Dr. Hülsmann-Krause liest heute persönlich aus ihren Buch „Reise zur Stille“. Während des absolut lautlosen Vortrags schläft die Autorin schließlich ein. Der Moderator verabschiedet die Gäste der Lesung sacht. Die Zuhörer sind sich einig: Dr. Hülsmann-Krause liest absolut fantastisch.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Zum Anbeißen! Jet-Ski, Boogie-Board oder Kite-Surfen findet Jette einfach nicht trendy genug. Sie braucht richtige Action. Deshalb macht sie mit Mike einen Haifisch-Verleih auf. Währenddessen sucht Promi-Luder Onka noch nach dem passenden Bikini, um mit den angriffslustigen Fischen ins Wasser zu steigen.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: „Haben sie eine gültige Ausrede?“ Als gewissenhafte Kontrolleurin stellt Anke Engelke die Schwarzfahrer in der U-Bahn zur Rede: Ein Geschäftsmann fällt unangenehm auf, weil er keine Ausrede parat hat. Weitere Fahrgäste versuchen zu helfen, aber auch mit der Gruppenausrede will es zunächst nicht klappen

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Im großen Ladykracher-Spezial gibt es nicht nur die besten Sketche der aktuellen Staffel, die lustigsten Ausschnitte von Onka & Co., sondern auch exklusive Einblicke hinter die Kulissen der preisgekrönten Sketch-Show!

programme.title: Beautiful People
programme.desc: Eine britische Comedyserie über den dreizehnjährigen Simon Doonan und seiner Familie in Reading. In dieser Folge erfahren wir, wie Simon seine Schneekugel von London bekam. Wenn Simon und Kylie eine neue, künstlerische Lehrerin bekommen, fangen sie sofort an von ihren Geschichten aus London zu träumen. Frau Prentice organisiert einen glamourösen Ski-Ausflug für die ganze Klasse, doch wenn die Eltern leider kein Geld dafür übrig haben, entschließen sich die beiden Jungs das Geld selber zu verdienen. Tante Hayley und Mutter Debbie streiten sich währenddessen wegen Hayleys neuer Freundin.

programme.title: De Troon
programme.desc: König Wilhelm III. macht die niederländische Krone innerhalb und außerhalb seines Reiches zum Gespött. Seine verbitterten Söhne verweigern beide den Kontakt oder die Nachfolge. Letztendlich entscheidet Wilhelm in der Hoffnung auf einen geeigneten Erben für eine zweite Ehe. Sein Ruf und seine abstoßenden Eigenschaften schrecken alle geeigneten Kandidatinnen ab, bis die Schwester der vorgesehenen Prinzessin des kleinen deutschen Fürstentums Waldeck-Pyrmont das Abenteuer annimmt.

programme.title: The Switch

programme.title: Brave New Girls

Doch ihre Eltern sind geschieden und kommen nicht gut miteinander aus, was das Treffen wenig reibungslos gestaltet. Außerdem kommt heraus, dass Angela einem Mann, den Jenna attraktiv fand, von ihrer Geschlechtsumwandlung erzählt hat und Jenna konfrontiert sie damit. All das Familiendrama belastet Jenna im Hinblick auf die Fashionshow, auf der sie laufen soll. Zu allem Überfluss hat PR-Managerin Vanessa schlechte Neuigkeiten...

programme.title: Threesome
programme.desc: Alice, Mitch und Richie machen einen Schwangerschaftskurs. Dort stellt sich heraus, dass Alice und Richie nicht gerade vorbildliche Eltern sind. Mitch dahingegen ist seiner väterlichen Rolle sofort gewachsen. Wenn Alice und Richie sich riesen Sorgen machen, bekommen sie von Mitch ein Roboterbaby mit dem sie schon mal üben können. Sie müssen das Baby füttern, wiegen und die Windeln wechseln. Hört sich an und für sich recht einfach an, aber ob die beiden Unerwachsenen das auch hinbekommen? Dann lernt Richie auch noch einen tollen Mann kennen: Dave.

programme.title: Lakshmis Haus des Schicksals
programme.desc: Lakshmi Niwas ist ein gefühlvolles Familiendrama, das in einem traditionellen Haushalt spielt, in dem Beziehungen, Werte und Schicksal eng miteinander verbunden sind. Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. Während Generationen aufeinandertreffen und verborgene Wahrheiten ans Licht kommen, muss Lakshmi zwischen Pflicht, Opferbereitschaft und persönlichem Glück ihren eigenen Weg finden. Die Serie erzählt von Vertrauen, Zusammenhalt und der Bedeutung von Familie – Themen, die universell verständlich sind. Lakshmi Niwas ist eine Geschichte über Hoffnung, emotionale Bindungen und die stille Stärke einer Frau, die aus einem Haus ein Zuhause macht.
